artTreatment: New edited bridge reference RGB sampled under byte-identical original rail and post alpha geometry.
placementCoordinates: Image top-left pixels from logical map top-left. Y increases down. Unity transform uses (origin.x+x/256,origin.y-y/256) with pivot(0,1).
rules: Rails only border W/S against void. All G/W/S count as walkable, including material changes and banks. Straight runs share continuous cream rails; posts occur only at run ends/turns and every fourth cell on long runs. Shared vertices receive one post.
renderOrder: bridge decks, rails by layer, boundary posts, then raised grass and props according to depth

qa.scope: All 1728 terrain assets plus 4 optional bridge illustrations, exact alpha/import metadata and actual RGB changes. No Unity execution.

sourcePolicy: New V11 raster interiors; native RGB sampled unchanged. Certified old alpha and metadata retained.
